page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c2.large is an x86_64 architecture server instance within the ecs.c2 family, running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated physical CPU cores with 16 vCPUs, establishing a 1.0 thread-per-core ratio. The instance is configured with 32.0 GB of system memory, which provides a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core.

This server configuration does not include any bundled local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for operating system and application data. It does not feature any GPU hardware accelerators, and it comes with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The dedicated CPU allocation and 1:2 CPU-to-RAM ratio position this instance for compute-intensive workloads that do not require massive memory footprints. The lack of hyperthreading ensures predictable single-threaded performance per vCPU. It is suitable for batch processing, web serving, and compute-bound applications where local storage is not a prerequisite.
